title: Krĩkatí dialect - Wikipedia
text: Krĩkatí[1]: 11 (also Krinkati[2]: 6 or Krikati[3]) is a Timbira dialect of the Northern Jê language group (Jê, Macro-Jê) spoken by the Krĩkatí in Terra Indígena Krikati in Maranhão, Brazil.
